text: Waited 35 minutes for two coffees on a quiet Sunday morning. Nobody apologised.
Ghee roast dosa was perfect and the chutneys were fresh. Quick service today.
Good filter coffee and friendly staff, a little noisy at lunch.
Found a hair in my biryani and the outlet refused to replace it.
Food was fine but the portion of paneer was small for the price.
Best idli vada in the area. Clean tables and polite servers.
Washroom was dirty and there were no tissues at the counter.

Manager shouted at us when we asked about the wrong order. Very rude.
Masala chai was great, delivery came hot and on time.
